request.text: Close-up foley of a small leafy tree canopy gently shaking back and forth as its branches are nudged. Broad overlapping swishes of many fresh leaves rubbing together, soft papery flutter and a little light twig movement, with small irregular pulses. Gentle miniature forest game scale, dry intimate recording. No chopping, bark tearing, wood knocks, wind roar, birds, insects, voices, music or reverb.
